new_findings.title: Repeated negative retest answers do not accumulate the stated further skip or doubled recheck interval
new_findings.preconditions: Imported nonoverplayed song: plays2, earlySkips3, lastPlay400 days ago, lastSkip40 days ago; counted-before-first-skip absent/0. probeDue true at each answer.
reproduction: Advance simulated clock31days. Assert probeDue(memory,now) again; retestVerdict(id,false) on second legitimate due retest.
At second verdict+240 days assert skipsWeigh remains true, because second extra skip should extend retestAfter(5) to365-day cap.
new_findings.expected: Two distinct eligible negative retests accumulate two extra skips; retain history facts separately if desired, but effective retest count/taste must reflect both, and duplicate delivery must not inflate them.
new_findings.actual: Stored earlySkips still3 and one overwritten verdict=-1; skipsWeigh uses earlySkips+1 forever while verdict staysnegative. Interval remains240 days; assertion expecting suppressed weight atday240 fails.
new_findings.impact: After repeated deliberate rejections, planner restores normal weight125days earlier than the stated doubled/capped retest semantics. Further negatives beyond the first never increase effective count.
new_findings.repair_direction: Track durable accumulated effective verdict count with occurrence/idempotence fences, or equivalent explicit state preserving real play/skip provenance; do not rewrite imported history or count repeated delivery as separate answers.
required_regressions: Distinct due negative retests with3 initial skips yield240 then365days; subsequent capped

new_findings.title: Unfenced concurrent opposite verdicts let late acknowledgement contradict last accepted answer
new_findings.reproduction: Observed probe; click Gern wieder while its HTTP acknowledgement is held; Eher nicht remains enabled and second click emits keep:false. Model accepts in request arrival order true then false; false reply arrives first. Release old true acknowledgement.
new_findings.expected: Either single pending answer prevents opposite submissions, or serialized/revision-fenced latest intention and acknowledgement remain coherent; stale reply must not replace latest feedback.
new_findings.actual: Requests [true,false], last accepted synthetic API state false, UI replaced negative thanks by Danke. Der Song kommt wieder wie jeder andere.
new_findings.impact: Honest preference acknowledgement is violated, and slow requests permit duplicate/opposite commands. This is an API-intercept client race proof, not evidence of a real provider/database write.
new_findings.repair: Track pending answer and identity/request revision; serialize or reject opposite pending clicks and discard superseded callbacks.
required_tests: slow first reply with opposite second request and reverse reply order
account and occurrence changes during pending verdict

new_findings.title: Successful verdict response discards failed playback advance result
new_findings.reproduction: Observed probe in Home with native controller; intercept retest response HTTP200 {skipped:false,skipError:Gerät ist nicht erreichbar.}; click Eher nicht. Same response is a valid Hub result for an unsuccessful Spotify advance.
new_findings.expected: Separate persisted preference acknowledgement from failed or unobserved playback advance, show actual failure and allow recovery; native route must follow actual controller contract (backend reviewer separately reproduces native no advance).
new_findings.actual: Only affirmative preference thanks appears, error omitted. Home neither consumes skipped/skipError nor sends nativePlayer/command handling for this action.
new_findings.impact: A device refusal is hidden while the listener expects rejection to move on. Preference save is valid; transport success cannot be inferred.
new_findings.repair: Preserve backend result shape in API typing and expose skip failure distinctly. Integrate negative verdict with correct native command route and stable occurrence fences as separately verified by backend reviewer; do not gratuitously rewrite transport state machine.
required_tests: real Hub fakeSpotify failed next after negative verdict
native observed probe negative verdict queue advance
old occurrence callbacks do not advance new song

new_findings.title: Prior answer hides the next probe of the same song in a continuously open Home
new_findings.reproduction: Answer Eher nicht on probe track0. Observe track1 next. Later synthetic authoritative state observes track0 in a distinct queue occurrence entry-retest-new, kind probe, same listener.
new_findings.expected: A fresh observed probe occurrence asks again.
new_findings.actual: Home retains answered track0 and renders old thanks; both answer buttons absent.
new_findings.impact: Low-frequency long-lived view loses explicit verdict buttons on repeat probe; reloading/navigation clears it. Synthetic occurrence lifecycle verified; actual months-long open physical browser NOT_RUN.
new_findings.repair: Scope answer to profile/session/entry identity and reset or derive display from current authoritative occurrence.
required_tests: same song distinct queue occurrence after intervening song
